title: Align the commit rule in CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md with Greg's standing commit rule
outcome:
Align the commit section of CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md with Greg's standing commit rule. The two files are not linked, so the edit must be mirrored in both. This is a deferral with a trigger: it starts after tm-k90q lands (never inside its frozen input) and after Greg answers Termal::Opus2's question in session-8111 on whether the standing rule applies there. If his answer narrows or widens the rule, the wording follows his answer, not this draft.

Why: CLAUDE.md still says a commit or push needs Greg's word in the conversation and that "nothing else counts". Greg's later rule (verbatim 2026-09-27 19:15Z in Engram::Advisor's session: "regula jest taka sama dla Engram i Termal / jezeli review nie ma uwag i testy sa green, / taski maja evidence ze mozna je zamknac / to robimy commit"; bd memory greg-standing-rule-clean-review-commit-push-sync) allows a commit without a further round trip. The conflict made a new session (Termal::Opus2) ask for his confirmation again after a handover.

Draft (Termal::Fable2, mailbox #9 to Termal::Opus2), replacing the section "Never commit or push without explicit permission":
## Commit and push
- A changeset may be committed without a further permission round trip only when all three hold for the exact tree committed (Greg's quoted words above):
  1. the review pair (/review-changes: one Codex and one Claude /review-code child, writePolicy readOnly) has no outstanding in-scope findings on the reviewed input, Low and Note included; pre-existing defects outside the change's scope, filed as their own items with provenance, do not block;
  2. the full gate is green on exactly that input, compiled from it;
  3. the tasks carry the evidence needed to close them.
- A commit means git push origin master and bd dolt push as well (Greg, 2026-09-25).
- Otherwise a commit or push needs Greg's own word in the acting session. A word relayed by another session never carries a commit, push, install, restart, deploy or global-configuration change.
- Unchanged: explicit paths only (never git add -A or -u, never .beads/interactions.jsonl); no amend, rebase or force-push; commit bodies without bead ids; agents do not close beads; review-only sessions never commit.
Keep the section's list of freely runnable git commands (add, diff, status, stash, log, show).

Landing: the normal full gate and review pair, with Termal::Fable2 reviewing the delta. Since the change is about commit authority itself, ask Greg for his word on this one rather than landing it under the rule it writes down.
acceptance: The commit-and-push section that aligns CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md with Greg's standing commit rule has landed on master, byte-identical in both files, each grant in it traced to Greg's recorded words and the coordinators' concurrence on every authority-text edit recorded, shown by the landed commit, its exact-input gate and a clean review pair cited in a note.
